text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Beside the hollow of the great tree, I 
spotted "something" about three times its 
size left behind...
choice_data_list: Are these... a mortar and pestle...?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~♪ We're about to pound some mochi☆ 
One of the younger girls in the dorm said 
she really wanted to eat some.
choice_data_list:
Even so, that mortar and pestle are way 
too big……!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
If we use a big one, we can make lots and 
lots, right~? Everyone can eat until their 
bellies are full☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
With buono mochi, eveeeeryone's happy♪ 
Bigger is always better, after all~☆

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Akebono-chaaan! The sticky rice is done 
steaming~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: All right! Shall we get started, then~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono took hold of the giant 
mallet and began pounding mochi together 
with the other Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaai-yah!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Heaaaaave-hoooooo~~!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
...Haaah~~! Whew~~! As expected, when it's 
big, it's heavy~!
choice_data_list: Why don't you take a break?

You're really putting a lot of muscle into 
pounding that, huh...

You're really putting a lot of muscle into 
pounding that, aren't you...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
...Haaah~~! Whew~~! As expected, when it's 
big, it's heavy~!
choice_data_list: Why don't you take a break?

You're really putting a lot of muscle into 
pounding that, huh...

You're really putting a lot of muscle into 
pounding that, aren't you...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
そうだね、休憩しよっか～。 
味見もしたいしねー♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you folks over there, care for a bite 
too~? It's piping hot and fresh off the 
mallet~☆

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Huh! Pounding mochi!? Wait, can I have 
some...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yup, eat up, eat up! Help yourself before 
it gets cold~♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
What do you want to dip it in~? We've got 
soy sauce and grated daikon radish♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Of couuurse! I'm gonna pound out a whole 
bunch more, so make sure you eat lots, 
okay~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Calling it a "taste test" was an 
understatement, but the mochi Hishi 
Akebono pounded was delicious. Smiles 
spread across everyone's faces.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Um, rather than raw strength, it's more 
like putting my "body weight" into it... I 
guess~?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Pounding it like this gives it amazing 
elasticity and makes it super delicious~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Since I'm so big, here's a special way of 
pounding mochi only I can do~♪
choice_data_list: I see, that's a good approach.
I see, that's a good approach.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Right~? Bigger is always better, after 
all~☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The mochi pounded with Hishi Akebono's 
specialized technique was delightfully 
springy and exceptionally delicious!
